sentences.en: The deputy accused the government of concealing its true intentions.
sentences.zh: 代理人在指责政府隐瞒真实意图。

sentences.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
sentences.zh: 我不在的时候，他将担任我的代理人。

sentences.en: The deputy mayor of Delhi was indirectly killed by rhesus monkeys.
sentences.zh: 德里副总统被猴子间接杀害了。

senses.zh: 代理人，副手，副职；代表，议员；（美国协助地方治安官办案的）警官
